d:
Ayushmann Khuranna is one of the few Bollywood actors who believe in doing content-driven movies and can pull off any character with conviction -- be it playing a sperm donor (Vicky Donor), or a visually impaired pianist (Andhadhun). We bring to Ayushmann Khurrana in an avatar that you may not have seen before.
His recent performances in movies like Dreamgirl, Badhai ho, Andhadhun are still talked about. His upcoming movie Bala has already created a buzz. Without any doubt, his movies are different and fun. Meet the man who is an "outsider" in Bollywood, but now has carved a niche for himself.
